title: Hypothesis (E1)–(E4) on a compatible system of extensions κ
body_html:
Hypothesis (E) on extensions $\kappa$

Assume $\Phi = (\mathscr{K}_+, \phi)$ as in [[node:coefficient_systems.semisimple_character_T_axioms]]. We further fix a family $\{\kappa_\mathcal{F}\}$ of representations indexed by facets of $\BSigma$ and require:

(E1) $\kappa_\mathcal{F}$ is an irreducible representation of $\hat K_\mathcal{F}$ such that $\kappa_\mathcal{F}|_{K_{\mathcal{F}, 0+}}$ is an irreducible $K_{\mathcal{F}, 0+}$-representation that is $\phi_\mathcal{F}$-isotypic as a $K_{\mathcal{F}, +}$-representation.

(E2) There exist coherent isomorphisms $r_{g, \mathcal{F}} : {}^g \kappa_\mathcal{F} \to \kappa_{g\mathcal{F}}$ for $g \in G$, with $r_{g, h\mathcal{F}} \circ r_{h, \mathcal{F}} = r_{gh, \mathcal{F}}$.

(E3) Induction-compatibility: for $\mathcal{E} \subseteq \overline{\mathcal{F}}$, $$\kappa_\mathcal{E}|_{\hat K_\mathcal{F} K_{\mathcal{E}, 0+}} \;\cong\; \cInd_{\hat K_\mathcal{F}}^{\hat K_\mathcal{F} K_{\mathcal{E}, 0+}} \kappa_\mathcal{F}.$$

(E4) For a vertex $x \in \mathcal{B}(M)$ and a facet $\mathcal{F}$ in $\mathcal{B}(M)$, the space $\Hom_{J_x \cap J_\mathcal{F}}(\kappa_x, \kappa_\mathcal{F})$ is one-dimensional and $M_x \cap M_\mathcal{F}$ acts on it trivially.

(E1)–(E4) say that the $\phi$-isotypic types extend coherently to a $G$-equivariant coefficient system $\mathcal{F} \mapsto \kappa_\mathcal{F}$ with all the right intertwining properties.

In §8 these hypotheses are geometrized — (E3) becomes the existence of restriction maps $\mathrm{proj}_{\mathcal{E}, \mathcal{F}}$ between the dual coefficient system $\kappa^*$ (see Dual coefficient system 𝒦*: F ↦ κ_F* (geometrization of (E3))), and (E4) becomes the intertwiner space coefficient system $\mathscr{R}_{x, \bullet}$ on $\mathcal{B}(M)$ (see [[node:depth_zero_reduction.R_xF_coeff]]).
